# Actuarius

> End-to-end actuarial analysis platform for insurers, reinsurers and consulting
> actuaries. IBNR loss reserving with Chain-Ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson,
> cash flow projection and IFRS 17 discounting in one system. An AI agent
> operates every module: it closes the valuation period, builds the model,
> produces the report and records the reasoning behind each decision in an
> audit trail.

Website: https://actuarius.com.tr (Turkish) · https://actuarius.com.tr/en (English)
Contact: info@actuarius.com.tr
Languages: Turkish, English
Audience: reserving actuaries, actuarial managers, audit and review teams

## What makes it different

Most loss reserving software is operated entirely by hand. Actuarius exposes
every module to an AI agent with 45 tools, so the agent can carry a valuation
from raw data to a signed-off report on its own — while every action stays
visible in the UI, reversible, and written to the audit trail.

## Modules

- **Data** — Claim, earned premium and large-loss data by valuation period.
  Uploaded as Excel/CSV or read directly from an Oracle table.
- **Reserving** — Development triangle, LDF selection and cell exclusion,
  parametric tail fitting (exponential, inverse power, power, Weibull),
  incurred loss ratio triangle, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, frequency-severity,
  ultimate loss and IBNR.
- **Cash Flow** — Quarterly and monthly cash flow projection from the payment
  pattern, kept consistent with the reserve.
- **Discounting** — IFRS 17 yield curve, illiquidity premium and risk
  adjustment producing the liability for incurred claims (LIC).

## Methods

- Chain-Ladder with volume-weighted, simple and geometric averaging
- Bornhuetter-Ferguson; a priori loss ratio derived from mature accident years
- Frequency-severity (average cost per claim) as a sanity check on pure CL
- Large-loss split: gross, attritional and large modelled separately
- Roll-forward between valuation periods and Actual vs Expected reconciliation

## AI agent

The agent holds 45 tools across four modules (reserving 31, cash flow 10,
discounting 2, data and navigation 2). It reads state, decides, applies the
change and writes the rationale. It respects user roles and model locks; every
step it takes is reversible and recorded.

## Governance

- Roles: admin and user separation
- Model lock: only one person edits a model at a time
- Audit trail: every write stored with who, when, what and why
- Versions: scenarios kept separately and compared side by side

## Pricing

- **Free** — ₺0, permanently free. 1 valuation period and 1 line of business,
  reserving module, AI agent, Excel export. No credit card required.
- **Pro** — ₺100/month. Unlimited periods and lines of business, cash flow and
  discounting modules, scenario versions, all agent tools.
- **Enterprise** — priced per organisation. Multiple users and roles, Oracle
  integration, enterprise audit workflow, on-premise deployment.

## For agents

- Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page above to get it as markdown instead
  of HTML — same content, no navigation or markup
- [Agent skills](https://actuarius.com.tr/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json):
  how to contact the team, how to read the site as markdown
- [OpenAPI description](https://actuarius.com.tr/openapi.json) ·
  [API catalog](https://actuarius.com.tr/.well-known/api-catalog)
- The landing page registers WebMCP tools (`actuarius_list_modules`,
  `actuarius_get_pricing`, `actuarius_search_faq`,
  `actuarius_prepare_contact_message`) for in-browser agents

# Türkçe özet

Actuarius, sigorta şirketleri ve aktüerler için uçtan uca aktüeryal analiz
platformudur. Chain-Ladder ve Bornhuetter-Ferguson ile IBNR rezerv hesabı,
nakit akışı projeksiyonu ve IFRS 17 iskonto tek sistemde toplanır. Dört modülde
45 aracı olan bir AI agent dönemi kapatır, modeli kurar, raporu üretir ve her
kararın gerekçesini denetim izine yazar. Türkçe sayfa: https://actuarius.com.tr
